Visit note | 2025-10-25 09:30 AM | Dr. Mostafizur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Babul Talukder, 74, male. Mr. Talukder returns for review regarding his ongoing knee discomfort, mentioning that he experiences stiffness in the morning for a few minutes, knee pain on the stairs, and a creaking knee. He is a madrasa teacher and notes these issues have become worse since standing all day at a shop in Cox's Bazar. He has Essential hypertension, which he manages daily. He denies locking, sudden giving way, or severe swelling. On examination: BMI 27.8, BP 150/86 mmHg, pulse 92 bpm, weight 49 kg. Range of motion is slightly restricted with mild crepitus on flexion, but ligament tests are stable. Assessment: Knee osteoarthritis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to do thigh-strengthening exercises daily, lose weight, and avoid squatting and sitting cross-legged on the floor. Follow-up in 6 weeks with physiotherapy.

Visit note | 2025-10-25 09:30 AM | Dr. Selina Parvin, Neurology | Patient: Tuhin Miah, 67, male. Mr. Miah attends for a follow-up consultation, explaining that his symptoms are worse at night and that he has noticed numbness in the toes. He works as a homemaker and reports his discomfort has been worse since walking barefoot at home in Noakhali. He has no known chronic comorbidities. He denies sharp shooting pains or open sores on his feet. On examination: reduced sensation at 8 of 10 monofilament test sites, BP 127/74 mmHg, pulse 88 bpm, weight 96 kg. He was advised to check the feet daily for cuts, wear soft closed shoes, and keep blood sugar under control. Follow-up in 6 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-10-25 09:30 AM | Dr. Ishrat Jahan, Psychiatry | Patient: Sajjad Gazi, 29, male.
